title: Quickstart model showcase and pricing callouts for launch and deprecation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a set of onboarding and quickstart UX assets and product screenshots for the next release focusing on: 1) new model showcase tiles across desktop and mobile, 2) compact pricing callouts for model catalog entries, and 3) deprecation badges and transition screens. Deliverables include responsive screenshot packs, Figma files with export-ready frames, SVG price badges, dark-mode variants, and a short guidance doc for PM/engineering to attach to release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop and mobile screenshot packs exported at required sizes (1440x900, 1200x800, 375x812, 360x800) and provided as PNG and WebP
Figma file with labelled frames, component instances for price callouts and deprecation badges, and a clear export guide
Price callout has both condensed and expanded variants and passes contrast and legibility checks for WCAG AA
Deprecation badge has a color + text variant and an illustrated transition state for onboarding flows
Localization-ready text placeholders present for EN/FR/DE/JA and a note on runtime string length limits
Assets uploaded to the release folder and linked in the release notes PR
updates: 2025-02-20 - AP: Ticket created after review with PM. Scope: new model tile + pricing callouts + deprecation badge. Initial ask attached to PRD.

2025-02-25 - JS (PM): Prefer 'per-token' callout for PLG docs; keep alternate 'per-1k' in collapsed tooltip. PM approves desktop layout, asks for condensed mobile variant.

2025-02-27 - MR: Added mobile condensed pricing callout and dark-mode frames. Noted localization constraints: German strings may overflow — added ellipsis guidance and a note for ENG to add truncation behavior.
